defects.summary: Svelte DNS page loaded DNS data from REST endpoints.
defects.resolution: Page load now returns relay/pubkey configuration only and the Svelte component starts a Nostr subscription on mount.

defects.summary: DNS store used REST request helpers and manual refresh semantics.
defects.resolution: Store now connects to relay metadata and relay WebSocket subscriptions, validates JSON/tag shape, applies replaceable semantics, handles EOSE/CLOSED/AUTH state, and has no DNS REST fetch helpers.
